top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four out of four staff lacked annual training hours.
